description: Mermaid CLI (mmdc) is an open-source command-line tool for rendering Mermaid diagram syntax to PNG, SVG, or PDF -- a local tool, not a hosted SaaS API.
access_notes: Installed locally via npm (no account, no signup); open-source under the mermaid-js GitHub organization.
api_notes: Single-purpose: renders Mermaid diagram text to image/PDF output via command-line invocation, not a network API.
main_blocker: This is a local CLI rendering tool with no accounts, network API, or auth surface, not a typical hosted SaaS integration -- a human should confirm whether a CLI-wrapper toolkit model fits the intended agent-integration pattern. Note: a separate commercial product, Mermaid Chart (mermaid.ai), has its own official MCP server, but that is a distinct product from this open-source CLI.
